♋ The Cancer Cloth. [OFFENSE]

Cloth Passive — The Boundary

You can see and speak with spirits, ghosts, and the recently dead. You automatically know the current Hit Point category (healthy, hurt, near death, dying) of every creature within 30 feet. You are trained in Medicine.

Techniques

  • 1st — Signature (L1) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Sekishiki Meikai Ha]
  • 2nd (L6) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Sekishiki Kisōen]
  • 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Sekishiki Konsō Ha]
  • 4th — Ultimate (L16) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Sekishiki Tenryū Ha]

Ascendant Boon — The Yellow Spring Opens [OFFENSE]

Any creature you reduce to 0 Hit Points dies, with no save.

Once per round as a free action, a creature within 30 feet at half Hit Points or fewer must attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC or take @Damage[8d6[void]] damage and be slowed 1.

You always know the direction of the nearest planar boundary.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Ascendant (Cancer)]

Zenith Boon — The Yellow Spring Is Here [removal]

Once per Zenith day, 30-foot emanation: every enemy at half Hit Points or fewer must attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC or die. Incapacitation.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Zenith (Cancer)]
